reuse.why: Puts the guard in the existing linkBankSyncAccount, which every provider-specific link handler already delegates to.

duplication.why: A single query and throw at the shared entry point; nothing is repeated per provider.

placement.why: The check sits at the top of the shared link routine in accounts/app.ts, before any side effect, alongside the other inline account queries in that function.

scope.why: Only the guard and focused tests covering closed, deleted, re-link and cross-provider cases.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; a named helper for 'is this bank account linked elsewhere' would read slightly better than the inline long SQL string.

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, used by the GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy.ai, Akahu and Enable Banking link handlers.
